## `--cursor <path>`

Default: ``

Existing cursor JSON file bound to one absolute delta log path.

## `--only-classes <classes>`

Default: ``

Keep a record when its delta has at least one named class.

## `--number <positive integer>`

Default: ``

Keep only deltas for this GitHub issue or pull-request number; this is not a result limit.

## `--advance`

Default: ``

Serialize this cursor, then atomically store the complete log tail scanned; rejected records are also advanced past. A concurrent mutator exits busy.

## `--format <json|text|template>`

Default: `json`

Output format: json for programs, text for operators, or one escaped line per delta from --template/--template-file.

## `--template <text>`

Default: ``

Inline one-line template. Required with --format template unless --template-file is set. Mutually exclusive with --template-file in the same source layer.

## `--template-file <path>`

Default: ``

Local regular file containing a one-line template. Paths resolve against the process working directory. Mutually exclusive with --template in the same source layer.

## `--template-sha256 <hex>`

Default: ``

CLI-only expected SHA-256 of the raw template file bytes, including a trailing newline. Requires --template-file. Compared case-insensitively.

## `--help`

Default: ``

Show human-readable help.

Default: ``

Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.

Default: ``

Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.
